
```{r}
set.seed(999)

curves <- c("usa", "gbr", "jpn", "cad")
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)
mat_cols <- paste0("X", sapply(mats, numeric_to_matname))

N <- 320
time_index <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("2016-01-01"), by = "day", length.out = N)

curve_lambdas <- c(
  usa = 0.0609,
  gbr = 0.0609,
  jpn = 0.0609,
  cad = 0.0609
)
```

```{r}
simulate_rw <- function(n, start, drift = 0, sd = 0.02) {
  start + cumsum(c(0, drift + rnorm(n - 1, sd = sd)))
}

simulate_ar1 <- function(n, phi = 0.9, sd = 0.08) {
  as.numeric(arima.sim(model = list(ar = phi), n = n, sd = sd))
}

build_curve_df <- function(yield_matrix, time_index, mats) {
  out <- data.frame(time = time_index, as.data.frame(yield_matrix))
  colnames(out) <- c("time", paste0("X", sapply(mats, numeric_to_matname)))
  out
}
```

```{r}
## USA carries the shared stochastic trends in L, S, and C
beta_usa <- cbind(
  level = simulate_rw(N, start = 2.75, drift = 0.0020, sd = 0.040),
  slope = simulate_rw(N, start = -1.80, drift = 0.0000, sd = 0.030),
  curve = simulate_rw(N, start = 0.85, drift = 0.0000, sd = 0.024)
)

## stationary latent states that drive cross-curve cointegrating spreads
ci_latent <- cbind(
  level = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.72, sd = 0.065),
  slope = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.66, sd = 0.055),
  curve = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.58, sd = 0.042)
)

curve_offsets <- list(
  usa = c(0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  gbr = c(0.35, -0.10, 0.08),
  jpn = c(-1.60, 0.30, -0.10),
  cad = c(0.20, -0.06, 0.12)
)

curve_loadings <- list(
  gbr = matrix(c(
    0.95, 0.10, 0.05,
    0.08, 0.88, 0.10,
    0.04, 0.12, 0.78
  ), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  jpn = matrix(c(
    0.72, -0.05, 0.08,
    0.10, 0.82, 0.06,
    -0.04, 0.10, 0.68
  ), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
  cad = matrix(c(
    0.86, 0.06, 0.10,
    0.05, 0.76, 0.12,
    0.02, 0.14, 0.84
  ), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
)

curve_local_ci <- list(
  gbr = cbind(
    level = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.42, sd = 0.026),
    slope = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.38, sd = 0.022),
    curve = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.34, sd = 0.018)
  ),
  jpn = cbind(
    level = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.46, sd = 0.024),
    slope = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.40, sd = 0.020),
    curve = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.36, sd = 0.016)
  ),
  cad = cbind(
    level = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.44, sd = 0.025),
    slope = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.36, sd = 0.021),
    curve = simulate_ar1(N, phi = 0.32, sd = 0.017)
  )
)

curve_ci_spreads <- list(
  usa = matrix(0, nrow = N, ncol = 3),
  gbr = ci_latent %*% curve_loadings$gbr + curve_local_ci$gbr,
  jpn = ci_latent %*% curve_loadings$jpn + curve_local_ci$jpn,
  cad = ci_latent %*% curve_loadings$cad + curve_local_ci$cad
)
colnames(curve_ci_spreads$usa) <- colnames(beta_usa)
colnames(curve_ci_spreads$gbr) <- colnames(beta_usa)
colnames(curve_ci_spreads$jpn) <- colnames(beta_usa)
colnames(curve_ci_spreads$cad) <- colnames(beta_usa)

curve_betas <- list(
  usa = sweep(beta_usa, 2, curve_offsets$usa, FUN = "+"),
  gbr = beta_usa + curve_ci_spreads$gbr,
  jpn = beta_usa + curve_ci_spreads$jpn,
  cad = beta_usa + curve_ci_spreads$cad
)

curve_betas$gbr <- sweep(curve_betas$gbr, 2, curve_offsets$gbr, FUN = "+")
curve_betas$jpn <- sweep(curve_betas$jpn, 2, curve_offsets$jpn, FUN = "+")
curve_betas$cad <- sweep(curve_betas$cad, 2, curve_offsets$cad, FUN = "+")

base_yields <- lapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
  curve_betas[[curve_name]] %*% NS_loadings(curve_lambdas[[curve_name]], mats)
})
names(base_yields) <- curves
```

```{r}
## pairwise USA-XYZ factor spreads are stationary by construction
true_ci_spreads <- lapply(setdiff(curves, "usa"), function(curve_name) {
  spread_df <- as.data.frame(curve_betas[[curve_name]] - curve_betas$usa)
  colnames(spread_df) <- c("L_spread", "S_spread", "C_spread")
  spread_df
})
names(true_ci_spreads) <- setdiff(curves, "usa")

ci_stationarity_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(true_ci_spreads, function(spread_df, curve_name) {
  tibble::tibble(
    curve = curve_name,
    factor = colnames(spread_df),
    mean = vapply(spread_df, mean, numeric(1)),
    adf_pvalue = vapply(spread_df, function(x) tseries::adf.test(x)$p.value, numeric(1))
  )
})

ci_stationarity_summary
```

```{r}
## true covariance-regression covariates used to create residual noise
Xt_true <- scale(ci_latent)
colnames(Xt_true) <- c("ci_level", "ci_slope", "ci_curve")

base_corr <- matrix(
  c(
    1.00, 0.55, 0.35, 0.50,
    0.55, 1.00, 0.30, 0.45,
    0.35, 0.30, 1.00, 0.28,
    0.50, 0.45, 0.28, 1.00
  ),
  nrow = length(curves),
  byrow = TRUE
)

term_scale <- seq(0.012, 0.035, length.out = length(mats))
idio_scale <- c(1.00, 0.95, 0.85, 0.92)

S0_true <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(mats), function(j) {
  sd_vec <- term_scale[j] * idio_scale
  diag(sd_vec) %*% base_corr %*% diag(sd_vec)
}), mat_cols)

B_template <- matrix(
  c(
    0.65, 0.10, 0.05,
    0.35, 0.70, 0.12,
    0.08, 0.25, 0.75,
    0.42, 0.18, 0.55
  ),
  nrow = length(curves),
  byrow = TRUE
)

B_true <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(mats), function(j) {
  tilt <- 0.008 + 0.020 * (j - 1) / (length(mats) - 1)
  sign_pattern <- c(1, 1, -1, 1)
  B_j <- tilt * B_template
  B_j[, 3] <- sign_pattern * B_j[, 3]
  B_j
}), mat_cols)

```

```{r}
## tenor-by-tenor residual draws
residual_draws <- setNames(lapply(mat_cols, function(mat_name) {
  cr_synthetic(
    N = N,
    B = B_true[[mat_name]],
    S0 = S0_true[[mat_name]],
    X = Xt_true,
    intercept = FALSE
  )
}), mat_cols)

synthetic_yields <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(curves), function(curve_idx) {
  curve_name <- curves[curve_idx]
  yield_matrix <- base_yields[[curve_name]]

  for (j in seq_along(mat_cols)) {
    yield_matrix[, j] <- yield_matrix[, j] + residual_draws[[mat_cols[j]]]$W[, curve_idx]
  }

  build_curve_df(yield_matrix, time_index, mats)
}), curves)
```

```{r}
## quick sanity check: curve shapes look realistic across tenors
snapshot_rows <- c(1, round(N / 2), N)

snapshot_panel <- purrr::imap_dfr(synthetic_yields, function(curve_df, curve_name) {
  curve_df[snapshot_rows, ] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(snapshot = c("start", "mid", "end"), curve = curve_name) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(time, snapshot, curve), names_to = "tenor", values_to = "yield") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(maturity_months = mats[match(tenor, mat_cols)])
})

ggplot2::ggplot(snapshot_panel, ggplot2::aes(x = maturity_months, y = yield, color = curve)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~snapshot, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = mats) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Synthetic Nelson-Siegel yield curves",
    x = "Maturity (months)",
    y = "Yield"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
## baseline NS fit on the synthetic yields
marginal_dns <- lapply(synthetic_yields, function(curve_df) {
  sc_fit(yields = curve_df, mats = mats, type = "nelson", lambdas = curve_lambdas[["usa"]], ts = FALSE)
})

ns_fit_mse <- setNames(vapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
  mean((marginal_dns[[curve_name]]$yields - as.matrix(synthetic_yields[[curve_name]][, -1]))^2)
}, numeric(1)), curves)

ns_fit_mse
```

```{r}
## first endogenous cross-curve fit on the synthetic data
synthetic_mc_fit <- mc_fit_end(
  yields = synthetic_yields,
  lambdas = curve_lambdas[["usa"]],
  cutoffs = c(4, 8),
  reference = "usa",
  curves = curves,
  mats = mats,
  X_trunc = FALSE,
  Xt_smooth = FALSE,
  smoother = "rm",
  COV_TEST = FALSE,
  CR_maxiter = 500,
  CR_tol = 1e-6
)
```
